output.summary: Zero deviations are a reporting artifact, not quality improvement. The February 2026 supervisor bonus penalty preceded the collapse of NCRs, while independent QC rejections (0.8% to 1.3%) and complaints (11 to 31 ppm) rose. Line 3's output edge is not transferable practice: badge data shows borrowed Line 1 and 4 technicians, with flat output per technician-hour. The hotline report describes undocumented rework on Line 3, and 71% of traceable luer-leak complaints come from Line 3 lots. The tubing switch fits poorly, since it came after the complaint rise began and affects all lines. Do not roll out Line 3 or unmask the reporter. Remove the penalty, offer amnesty, and run an independent investigation including shipped-lot risk. Whether the Plant Manager directs the lending is not established.
